questions.question: A news website wants to automatically identify the main talking points in each article so that it can generate topic tags. Which text analysis technique should the website use?

options.why: Language detection identifies the language of the text, not its main topics.
Correct. Key phrase extraction returns the main talking points in a document.
PII detection finds personal information such as phone numbers and email addresses.
Sentiment analysis determines whether text is positive, negative, neutral or mixed.

questions.explanation: Key phrase extraction identifies the main concepts discussed in a text, which can be used as tags.

questions.scenario: A smartphone manufacturer analyzes product reviews. A typical review states: 'The camera is excellent, but the battery drains quickly.' The manufacturer wants to know which product features customers like and which they dislike.
questions.question: Which capability should the manufacturer use?

options.why: Correct. Opinion mining links each opinion to its target, such as camera (positive) and battery (negative).
Entity linking identifies which real-world entity a name refers to. It does not assign opinions to features.
Extractive summarization selects key sentences. It does not label opinions by feature.
Language detection identifies the language only.

questions.explanation: Opinion mining is an aspect-level extension of sentiment analysis that associates sentiment with specific targets in the text.

questions.question: A support team must remove phone numbers, email addresses and account numbers from chat transcripts before the transcripts are shared with analysts. Which capability should the team use?

options.why: Location entities do not include phone numbers, email addresses or account numbers.
Key phrase extraction finds talking points and does not redact personal data.
Correct. PII detection identifies personal data and can return a redacted version of the text.
A summary may omit some details, but it does not reliably detect and redact personal data.

questions.explanation: PII detection in Azure Language identifies and categorizes personal information and returns redacted text.

questions.question: Which TWO statements about summarization in Azure Language are correct?

options.text: Extractive summarization selects the most important sentences from the original text
options.why: Correct. Extractive summaries reuse sentences from the source.

options.text: Abstractive summarization generates new sentences that capture the main ideas
options.why: Correct. Abstractive summaries are written in new words.

options.text: Extractive summarization translates the text into another language
options.why: Translation is a separate capability. Extractive summarization keeps the original language and sentences.

options.text: Abstractive summarization returns only a sentiment label
options.why: Sentiment labels come from sentiment analysis, not summarization.

questions.explanation: Extractive summarization picks existing sentences, while abstractive summarization writes a new, shorter summary.

questions.question: A document mentions 'Jordan'. An application must determine whether the text refers to the country or to a person and return a reference link for the correct one. Which capability should the application use?

options.why: Correct. Entity linking disambiguates an entity by matching it to a known reference and returns a link.
Sentiment analysis determines opinion, not the identity of an entity.
Key phrase extraction returns talking points without disambiguating them.
Language detection identifies the language of the text.

questions.explanation: Entity linking identifies which real-world entity is meant and links it to a knowledge base entry.
